criteria.name: Clarity and language quality
criteria.descriptor: Grammar, spelling, punctuation and sentence construction. Can a reader follow every sentence without re-reading it?

criteria.name: Organisation and coherence
criteria.descriptor: Logical structure, sensible paragraphing, and a clear flow from problem to method to result.

criteria.name: Technical depth and accuracy
criteria.descriptor: How well the work explains its design choices, methods and trade-offs, and whether the technical claims are correct and precise.

criteria.name: Evidence and specificity
criteria.descriptor: Concrete details that can be checked: numbers, measurements, parameter values, named tools, results, failures and what was learned from them.

criteria.name: Authentic voice and original reasoning
criteria.descriptor: Does the text read as the authors' own account of work they did, with their own decisions and reasoning, rather than generic statements that could describe any project?
